title: A closer look at daily usage
summary:
Hourly usage views and downloadable-free media metadata led the day, with a little app-catalog housekeeping behind them.

The usage dashboard now shows hourly UTC buckets when you select a day; week and month views still group usage by day. Pollen charts also retain small fractional values instead of rounding them to zero.

The media API gained GET /{hash}/metadata, returning a file’s hash, content type, byte size, and upload time when recorded. The endpoint and its actual response fields are now documented.

The app catalog’s metrics and health-check snapshot was refreshed, while the README now credits the creators of TimeMachine Chat, Scene2Text, and AI Models Laboratory.

daily.title: Hourly usage views
daily.text: Select a day in the usage dashboard to see hourly UTC usage. Pollen charts now show even small fractional amounts.

daily.title: Media metadata endpoint
daily.text: Use `GET /{hash}/metadata` to check a stored file’s type, size, and recorded upload time without downloading it. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
